items.question: What size businesses do you work with?
items.answer: We support SMEs, growing startups, and established businesses across the GCC.

items.question: Can you work with our existing accountant?
items.answer: Yes. We can collaborate with your current accountant or finance team.

items.question: Do you offer one-time projects?
items.answer: Yes. We support both ongoing monthly engagements and project-based work.

items.question: What accounting systems do you support?
items.answer: We work with major accounting platforms and finance tools.

items.question: How do you price your services?
items.answer: Pricing depends on scope, business size, and required support.

items.question: Do you provide strategic finance support?
items.answer: Yes. Our Fractional CFO services help businesses with planning and decision-making.
